reviewContext.toolConstraintNote: This review session had NO Bash/shell/network tool access (Read/Write/Edit/Grep/Glob only). `git diff main --stat` and `node --test` could NOT be independently executed. Test-pass claims (gig 82/82, lending 164/164) were cross-checked by counting `test(...)` block occurrences per file via Grep and matched the builder's own evidence/sprint-1-green-phase-round2.log claims EXACTLY (gig: 82 across 8 files; lending: 164 across 10 files) -- strong corroboration, not independent execution. The REQ-116 flaky-test-is-pre-existing claim and the exact green/red pass/fail transcripts are read from evidence/sprint-1-{red,green}-phase-round2.log, not independently re-run. All 5 round-1 findings (FIND-001..005) were independently re-verified via full-file reads of the actual current source (not just the evidence logs) against their own claimed fixes; FIND-001, FIND-003, FIND-004, FIND-005 hold up under independent static re-verification. FIND-002's fix genuinely resolves round-1's specific complaint (unreachable dead code -> now reachable from lending-orchestrator.mjs step 6, confirmed by direct read + repo-wide grep showing zero other production call sites needed), but independent re-verification of FIND-002's surrounding data flow (not requested verbatim by round-1, but implied by 'confirm reachable in production... fail-open by default') surfaced a NEW, critical, round-2-introduced defect: FIND-101 (see below) -- the wiring reads a citizen-record field name that does not exist in this repo's own canonical, tested registry schema, so the gate silently fails EVERY borrower the instant a lender configures it, the opposite of dead-code-but-safe.

evidence.description: FIND-001 fix re-verified by full read: appendDripLog (status:'broadcast') now runs immediately after `sent.hash` exists (line 212-218), strictly BEFORE waitForTransactionReceipt (line 220-225) -- the only call site, no second append after the receipt resolves. No exception path from `drip()` broadcasting onward can leave a real, broadcast drip uncounted against maxDripsPerDay. Genuinely fixed.

FIND-002's SPECIFIC round-1 complaint (isBorrowerEligibleWithReputationGate has zero production call sites) is genuinely resolved: it is now called at runLockedIssuance step 6, the real function backing executeLoanIssuanceAttempt (wake-gate.mjs:191's own production entry point). REQ-012's corrected acceptance criteria ('grep returns >=1 match'; 'a dedicated test proves a configured deps.reputationGate is genuinely consulted'; 'unset-config default reaches active identically') are all literally satisfied by lending-orchestrator.test.mjs:225-253. BUT the wiring itself is functionally broken for real data -- see FIND-101: `freshBorrower.agentId` (lending-orchestrator.mjs:392) does not match this repo's own canonical citizen-registry field `agent_id` (skills/self/spawn/lib/child-spec.js:65, spawn-orchestrator.mjs:680, both independently tested at __tests__/spawn-orchestrator.test.mjs:191/538 and __tests__/child-spec-erc8004.test.js:37/66/85), so every real borrower is rejected the instant a lender configures the gate -- the design spec's own G3 goal ('閾値設定時に実績不足 borrower が弾かれる') is not met; ALL borrowers are rejected, not just insufficient ones.

The 2026-07-12 spec correction for REQ-012 (adversary round-2 FIND-002) is read verbatim and matches the actual wiring location (lending-orchestrator.mjs step 6) exactly -- the spec-code alignment itself is honest and accurate; the remaining gap is a pure implementation defect (wrong field name), not a spec ambiguity.

FIND-003 fix re-verified: both exception-throwing branches (sendDripFn itself throws, line 190; waitForTransactionReceipt throws post-broadcast, line 224) are now genuinely covered, including the specific FIND-001 double-drip-past-cap retry proof (lines 252-259: asserts sendCount stays at 1 on retry). Genuinely fixed.

FIND-004 fix re-verified: all 3 silent `if (!base.eligible) return;` no-ops are gone, replaced with loud `assert.equal(base.eligible, true, ...)` preconditions (lines 58-59, 72-73, 85-86); the fixture itself was corrected to the known-good `fuel.provider`/`humanDependencies` shape. Genuinely fixed.

The FIND-002 wiring test set is a NEW edge-case gap in its own right (see FIND-101): it only ever exercises isBorrowerEligibleWithReputationGate with an INJECTED `deps.reputationGateFn` stub (never the real production default `passesOnchainReputationGate`) against a borrower fixture (`baseCitizen()`, line 80-91) that -- correctly, matching the real registry schema -- has no `.agentId`/`.agent_id` field at all. No test anywhere in this feature's 45 new tests calls the REAL default reputationGateFn with a CONFIGURED gate against a citizen shaped like a genuine production registry row, so the agentId field-name defect (FIND-101) produces zero test failures despite being a complete functional inversion of the feature's stated purpose.

Single appendDripLog call site, `status:'broadcast'` recorded atomically at broadcast time -- re-verified no other code in this repo reads the drip log's `status` field for anything other than this module's own `countRecentDrips` (which is status-agnostic, counting by address+timestamp only), so this is not a regression against any other consumer (repo-wide grep for `dripLogPath`/`gas-drip-log` confirms ensure-gas.mjs/its own test are the only readers).

`borrowerAgentId: freshBorrower.agentId` -- a straightforward wrong-property-access bug: `freshBorrower` is whatever wake-gate.mjs's `buildDefaultGetCitizen` returns, a raw spread of the on-disk registry row (`{...citizen, balanceUsd}`, wake-gate.mjs:64-71), which per this repo's own canonical, tested schema carries the borrower's ERC-8004 identity under `agent_id`, never `agentId`. This single character-casing/underscore mismatch makes the entire G3 configured-gate path unconditionally fail-closed against every real borrower -- see FIND-101 for full evidence chain.

FIND-004's fix is structurally sound: no duplication introduced, the corrected fixture reuses lending-gate.test.mjs's own known-good BASE_BORROWER shape rather than inventing a new one, matching this repo's own stated convention.

Re-verified wake-gate.mjs itself was NOT modified this round and remains structurally sound: findSelectedPair (line 78) is a pure, synchronous pre-filter using the raw isBorrowerEligible (never isBorrowerEligibleWithReputationGate) purely for candidate selection; every selected pair is still routed through executeLoanIssuanceAttempt (line 191), which now authoritatively enforces the (functionally-broken, per FIND-101, but structurally correctly-placed) gate at step 6. The design's own 'wake-gate.mjs need not be separately wired' claim (behavioral-spec.md:181-184) is structurally accurate regardless of FIND-101.

No dead code, no unnecessary abstraction; the FIND-001 fix is a single, minimally-invasive relocation of one existing appendDripLog call plus a status-value change, matching the file's own established comment-density/DI conventions.

FIND-005 re-verified: PROP-043/044/045 honestly re-confirmed NOT-RUN this round too, same documented money-safety-wall blocker, no fabricated or simulated E2E claim found anywhere in state.json, the evidence logs, or code comments. This specific finding's remediation intent (honesty, not fabrication) is genuinely satisfied and is NOT, by itself, a blocking gap for this round.

PROP-048 ('a configured deps.reputationGate is genuinely consulted... and its rejection refuses the loan') is marked Required:true/PASS via node:test, but as implemented (lending-orchestrator.test.mjs:225-246) it only proves the DI SEAM is wired, not that the real production default (passesOnchainReputationGate, deps.reputationGateFn omitted) produces a correct eligibility decision against a realistically-shaped citizen record -- the exact gap that let FIND-101 land as an undetected critical regression. The verification architecture's own proof-obligation table has no PROP-ID asserting 'the real reputationGateFn, given a genuine registry-shaped borrower record and a configured gate, evaluates correctly' -- this is the same class of gap round-1's own FIND-005 finding flagged for PROP-045 ('a testnet run of PROP-045 would only demonstrate the standalone function works in isolation'), now manifesting one layer earlier, at the unit level, because the mock-based proof was accepted as sufficient.

convergenceSignals.priorRoundFindingsResolutionNote: FIND-002's specific round-1 complaint (unreachable dead code) is resolved -- isBorrowerEligibleWithReputationGate is now genuinely called from the real production loan-issuance entry point. A NEW, distinct, round-2-introduced defect (FIND-101) was found in the SAME wiring: a wrong citizen-record field name (`agentId` vs the repo's own canonical `agent_id`) makes the now-reachable gate unconditionally reject every real borrower once configured, defeating G3's entire purpose. This is reported as a new finding, not a re-opened FIND-002, because the specific defect (reachability) round-1 identified is genuinely fixed; the new defect is a different, previously-undetected bug this round's own fix introduced/exposed.
